_README: PadSplit's applicant list has no export/API and no history — it only shows CURRENT status + the date of the LAST change, overwriting the earlier date every time someone advances. So we keep our own history here. Workflow: whenever you check PadSplit's applicant list, paste the current full list to Claude. Claude matches each person by name against 'people' below, appends a new history entry ONLY when their status actually changed since last time (dated the day we noticed — that's the best precision possible without PadSplit exposing true transition dates), and adds anyone new as a new person. The more often you paste an update, the more accurate the stage-transition dates get.
_statusValues: Valid statuses, in pipeline order: registered, applying, pending, approved (screened) -> move_in (booked a room, host TBD) -> then either booking_fee_waived (moved into OUR room - the goal, instant) or paid (moved into another host's room, stayed 14+ consecutive days, $250 payout).
